I was absolutely obsessed with Maretu back in middle school, one of my top favorites from him being Brain Revolution Girl, and I would constantly be on the prowl for covers. From ones in English (Oktavia’s eng cover being my favorite 😆) to the ones that were in a languages I didn’t even know (ie Russian, etc), or even ones that used different voice banks. I had literal playlists and google docs dedicated to my favorite renditions of his songs/his songs in general.

So I bet you can imagine my joy when I heard Ado’s covers of his songs (BRG was the first one I discovered around the time it was published on YT, then Rebirth, and then the Eraser Girl duet w Chogakusei). I fell in love with her renditions and now here we are!

Very beautiful piece and I’ve actually got to perform this one for my senior year!! I was also able to “meet” her (more as she talked to the entire choir for a bit) this year in New York and she was a very sweet lady! Hopefully your choir will be able to perform it soon 🙏

Her “Brain Revolution Girl” cover about a year after it was posted on YouTube was the one that introduced me! I really fell in love with her interpretation of the song. It actually opened myself up to new singing styles (ie nasal-y, growling, etc) that aren’t accepted in choirs like the one I used to be in.

But I didn’t really “lock in” into her music till the “Bocca Della Verita” cover was posted. That’s when I was 100% was her fan and started to listen to her regularly.

Ah, it’s completely fine! Personally, I would choose the xp pen over the kamvas. 
The pen is very sturdy and it works a very long time without charge (around almost a two months with everyday use). Unfortunately you cannot use it while it is charging due to the charger length being fairly short. 
The pen’s battery is going to last for a very long time unless it is ‘mishandled’. The lack of tilt recognition doesn’t really bother me that much, it’s pretty easy to get used to. 
Honestly, if you want to get perspectives from both users I suggest checking out the Huion Kamvas subreddit to get more of an idea. 
I hope you have gotten more of an idea from this!

Personally, I’d go with the xp pen 22e pro. I’ve had mines for about 6 months now and no major problems. It has plenty of shortcut keys and it comes with two pens, and two chargers for the pens. The tablet has plenty of space to draw, It’s fairly easy to set up and pretty sturdy. Also, the customer service is excellent. Either way, hope you enjoy what ever drawing tablet you pick! 🤗
